[Photograph: REUNION COMMITTEE MEETING AT THE HOME OF MR. GUS W. THOMASSON, JUNE 5, 1938
Seated: A. J. Chesworth, W. D. Stinnett, Galbraith, McMahon, Mrs. May, J. B. Mrs. May, G. W. Thomasson,
Mrs. J. P. Palmer, J. F. Wingo, J. B. Moore
Standing: A. Reynolds, W. A. Hawkins, J. B. Mason, Mrs. J. F. Barnett]
notes: Printed page number 193 appears at bottom center. Full-page photograph with caption identifying committee members at meeting at home of Gus W. Thomasson, June 5, 1938.
